description: This file defines a 'timeout' decorator for both synchronous and asynchronous functions, utilizing threading and asyncio to enforce execution time limits and raise custom exceptions on timeout.

classes.name: _LoopWrapper
classes.description: A thread class that manages an asyncio event loop for running asynchronous tasks with timeout control.

methods.name: timeout
methods.description: A decorator factory that creates a decorator to enforce a timeout on both sync and async functions, raising a specified exception if the timeout is exceeded.

methods.name: _LoopWrapper.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the thread with a new asyncio event loop.

methods.name: _LoopWrapper.run
methods.description: Runs the event loop forever in the thread, handling exceptions and closing the loop on termination.

methods.name: _LoopWrapper.stop_loop
methods.description: Stops the event loop and cancels all pending tasks.
